svg.title: Anatomy of the impedance plot
svg.text: one tab per computed PWR; red icon = failed
log scale; unit Ω / mΩ / µΩ (View ▸ |Z| unit)
log scale, sweep range of the Sweep tab
nearest grid point under the mouse
bare plane + PAD via, no decaps
|Z| at the markers for every PWR
Mouse: left-drag = pan, wheel = zoom, right-drag = zoom one axis, right-click = menu; View ▸ Reset zoom (Ctrl+0) restores the full range.
Low end falls at −20 dB/decade (capacitive, no VRM modelled); dips = decap series resonances; peaks = anti-resonances / plane resonances.
